import pandas as pd

print(Path("table.csv").read_text())
print(Path("summary.txt").read_text())

source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("y=df['Trade_Balance_2021'],\n    name='2020", "y=df['Trade_Balance_2020'],\n    name='2020")
source = source.replace("y=df['Trade_Balance_2020'],\n    name='2021", "y=df['Trade_Balance_2021'],\n    name='2021")
source = source.replace("fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(", "fig.add_trace(go.Bar(", 3)
source = source.replace("title='GDP Growth (%)',\n        side='left'", "title='Trade Balance (Billion USD)',\n        side='left'")
source = source.replace("title='Trade Balance (Billion USD)',\n        overlaying='y'", "title='GDP Growth (%)',\n        overlaying='y'")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))

print("Axis titles:", fig.layout.yaxis.title.text, "/", fig.layout.yaxis2.title.text)
print("Bar mode:", fig.layout.barmode)
